scope.claim: development-only dataset discovery; no confirmation, promotion, or public API decision
scope.question: Which real-image structured targets are recoverable from frozen embeddings and show a stable material advantage for a nonlinear head over a linear ridge head?
scope.hardness_policy: absolute task difficulty is not an admission criterion; the screen selects nonlinear-but-recoverable target geometry rather than generally unsolved tasks
scope.outcomes_previously_observed: the source embeddings and earlier occupancy targets have been analyzed, but the new center/aspect target head outcomes have not
scope.future_validation: all admitted tasks remain development evidence; an untouched validation must use the reserved backbones and preferably new structured datasets

target_recipes.box_area_fraction: inclusive annotation-box pixel area divided by image pixel area
target_recipes.box_center_x: mean of inclusive x endpoints divided by width-1
target_recipes.box_center_y: mean of inclusive y endpoints divided by height-1
target_recipes.box_log_aspect_ratio: natural log of ((inclusive box width/image width)/(inclusive box height/image height))
target_recipes.mask_area_fraction: fraction of official trimap pixels labeled foreground or boundary
target_recipes.mask_centroid_x: mean foreground-or-boundary x coordinate divided by width-1
target_recipes.mask_centroid_y: mean foreground-or-boundary y coordinate divided by height-1
target_recipes.mask_log_bbox_aspect_ratio: natural log of ((inclusive foreground bbox width/image width)/(inclusive foreground bbox height/image height))

seed_derivation.continuous_selector_panel: replicate_seed + dataset_position*100 + target_position*10; the selector owns its separate backbone-position expansion

rows.source_cohort_note: each source cohort is disjoint across training replicates and evaluation; the bbox cohorts were originally stratified by area, so all results are discovery evidence

preprocessing.pca_fit_scope: training rows only, separately per dataset, seed, and backbone
preprocessing.reuse: the fitted PCA geometry is shared by all four targets for a dataset-seed-backbone cell

heads.selection: three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV maximizing R2, followed by one fixed held-out evaluation

admission.stable_backbone_definition: the same unique nonlinear held-out winner occurs in at least two of three replicate seeds

reporting.selection_policy: report every admitted task and family coverage; do not manufacture missing nonlinear families or inspect reserved-backbone outcomes
